description_en: Modify the skill level of a specified agent in one or more skill groups under a specified instance
description_zh: 修改指定实例下指定坐席的一个或多个技能组下的技能等级
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-skill-levels-of-user --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --skill-level-list skillGroupId_:_skillgroup1@ccc-test_,_skillLevel_:1_,_skillGroupId_:_skillgroup2@ccc-test_,_skillLevel_:10 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySkillLevelsOfUser

parameters.description_en: A JSON-formatted string representing an array of objects specifying skill levels for skill groups. Each array element is an object containing two fields: skillGroupId and skillLevel. Set skillGroupId to the ID of the skill group you want to modify, and set skillLevel to the desired skill level, which must be an integer from 1 to 10. A lower value indicates stronger business capability and the ability to handle more calls per unit time.
parameters.description_zh: 技能组的技能等级列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是一个对象，包含两个字段：skillGroupId和skillLevel，skillGroupId填写想要修改的技能组ID，skillLevel填写想要修改的技能等级，取值范围1-10，值越小，业务能力越强，单位时间内能处理更多的通话。
